assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Premium mature Cyberpunk RED 2045 RPG catalogue illustration, detailed hand-drawn CEL SHADING. Fine varied ink contour and crisp large shadow planes, realistic adult proportions and engineered construction, secondary reflected-light shapes, clear differentiation of cloth, metal, polymer and glass. Restrained local wear, materially convincing details concentrated around the subject, softer lower-contrast atmospheric background. Lived-in retrofuturist city after economic collapse, repaired practical technology. Cinematic light, readable main subject and generous safe margins. Never cute or toy-like, no thick uniform icon outline, no photoreal photograph or glossy 3D render, no uniform grain, no unreadable pseudo-text, no letters, logos, watermark, borders or UI. 3:2 depiction of fictional illicit street substances as catalogue still life: a compact tarnished graphite stash box on a worn alley-market counter containing two tiny violet and blue sealed vials and a plain blister strip of amber tablets. Entire objects readable, hardware with cyan latch. Mood uneasy and subdued, closed shutters and blurred city light behind. No person consuming, no recipes, no labels, no real brands, no glamorized party scene.
assets.exportRecipe: Centered crop and Lanczos3 resize; opaque quality 88, no creative edits
